description: This file defines the PHP class PaymentMethod, which is part of the Opencart system under the namespace Opencart.Catalog.Controller.Checkout. It contains methods related to handling checkout payment methods, including displaying available payment options, saving selected payment method, and handling comments and agreements. The class extends a base controller and interacts with cart, session, language, url, models, and response components to process checkout payment logic.

classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing checkout payment methods, including displaying available methods, saving selected options, and handling user comments and agreements during checkout.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the payment method selection page, loading language resources, retrieving payment methods, and preparing view data.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Returns available payment methods as a JSON response after validating the cart and session data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the selected payment method, performing validation on cart, addresses, and payment options, then returning success or error as JSON.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Handles submission of order comments, updating session and order records accordingly, responding with success or error as JSON.

methods.name: agree
methods.description: Handles user agreement submission, updating session data and responding with success or error as JSON.
